# Genesis Apocryphon Column 6 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QapGen (Cave 1), Col. 6 | **Condition:** Nearly destroyed

---

**6:1** [...] Noah [...] the earth [...]

**6:2** [...] wickedness had grown [...] great [...] across the earth [...]

**6:3** [...] all humanity [...] every living creature [...]

**6:4** [...] corrupted [...] steeped in evil [...]

**6:5** [...] in the sight of the Lord [...]

**6:6** [...]

**6:7** [...]

**6:8** [...]

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 6 is almost completely destroyed. The few surviving words paint a picture of a world drowning in wickedness — the very corruption that will necessitate the flood Enoch prophesied in Column 5. Noah now stands at the threshold of judgment.*
